A.note: Close, high-angle view with a dense terracotta roof mass and a convincing wall line. The water is textured and has wakes, and the ships are small but read as sailing ships. The buildings are somewhat blocky and repetitive. The land is cropped, so the bay and the town's setting are lost. The sea is very saturated.

B.note: The widest and best-composed panorama. It has a diagonal town and wall leading the eye, a distant ridge, a hazy horizon and a grassy foreground with scrub. The ships sit on pink or magenta discs that look like game tokens. The terrain is smooth and only lightly textured. The water is a little flat.

C.note: Same layout as B but with oversaturated flat blue water and yellow-green terrain that looks like a map or diorama. The ship markers are even more garish. The foreground is bare, and the distant ridge is dark and flat.

why: B has the most convincing panoramic depth, atmosphere and terrain; A is more textured but cropped and tight; C is the most garish, flat and toy-like.
top_fix_for_best: Remove the pink halos under the ships and replace them with proper hulls, sails and wakes, then add terrain texture such as fields, trees and rocks to the foreground slope.
